equipment_type: Multi-boiler sequencer (hot water boiler plant) via BACnet gateway
applies_to: Cleaver-Brooks HSC panels sequencing up to 10 condensing and 10 non-condensing boilers, read through a ProtoNode RER gateway.
summary: The ProtoNode maps the HSC boiler-plant controller to BACnet. Each condensing boiler (1-10) and non-condensing boiler (A-J) has a block of state, alarm word, hours, cycles, status bits, inlet and outlet temperature; the plant section adds header and return temperatures, active setpoints, reset-curve settings, lead/lag order, pump and damper module data and run counts. Four AVs let the BMS enable the system, send a setpoint and outdoor temperature, and write a heartbeat.
notes: Each Cleaver-Brooks controller on the ProtoNode is its own BACnet device; the object instances below are the same on every device.
Access follows the guide's write-point stars: the starred AV/BV objects are writable, everything else is read-only.
The guide gives no engineering units or state texts; units appear only where the object name carries them (DEG F / DEG C).
Where a description is filled in, it gives the register from the guide's Modbus column.

source.title: Cloud Enabled ProtoNode Gateway Startup Guide (RER/LER) for interfacing Cleaver-Brooks products

integration.summary: Enable the plant with AV 3 and write the setpoint with AV 1, keep AV 4 heartbeat updated, and optionally send outdoor air temperature on AV 2. Read system mode, header and return temperatures, boiler counts and the alarm words.
integration.enable: AV 3 Remote Modbus System Enable enables the plant; AV 1 Remote Modbus Setpoint Value sends the setpoint.
integration.heartbeat: AV 4 Modbus Heartbeat is written by the BMS; the guide does not state the timeout.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 2 Remote Modbus Outdoor Air Temp takes an outdoor air temperature from the BMS.
setup: BACnet Device Instance = the controller's Modbus Node-ID + Node_Offset (default 50,000), so Node-ID 1 = 50001. Change Node_Offset in the ProtoNode web configurator to pick other instances.
The ProtoNode RER does BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP, selected on its S bank DIP switches.
BACnet MS/TP: one MAC address (1-127) for the whole ProtoNode on the A bank DIP switches; baud on B0-B3 (38400 factory default).
BACnet IP: default ProtoNode address 192.168.1.24; change it in the web configurator.
